content.title: Implement detail page back link, ID display, inline title edit

content.description:
Implement the three IssueDetailPage gaps confirmed by the validator:

1. Add a 'Back to issues' link in the IssueDetailPage MAIN render branch (not just the error branch). It should navigate to the issue list.
2. Display the raw issue ID in the DOM on the detail page (e.g. alongside or below the title).
3. Implement inline title editing — symmetric with the existing description inline edit (editingDescription state). Clicking the title h1 should reveal an input.

Reference: IssueDetailPage.tsx. The validator's reproduction comment (on this issue) has the exact failure details.

## Reproduction results — IssueDetailPage UX gaps (from mqe054i6vm)

Ran `npx playwright test e2e/phase2-validation.spec.ts` against current source. **Result: 51 passed, 4 failed.** The 4 failures are deterministic (same in a full-suite run and in isolation), confirming all 3 gaps reproduce.

**Baseline note:** `IssueDetailPage.tsx`, `AppLayout.tsx`, and `phase2-validation.spec.ts` are unchanged since commit `1afdf15` (pre-Phase-4), so current source == pre-Phase-4 baseline for these gaps — they are pre-existing, NOT Phase 4 regressions.

### Gap 1 — 'Back to issues' link missing (CLEAN reproduction)
- `phase2-validation.spec.ts:731 'navigates from list to detail page'` → FAILS at line 754: `getByText("Back to issues")` → "element(s) not found".
- `phase2-validation.spec.ts:760 'navigates back from detail to list'` → FAILS at line 779: same cause.
- Root cause: `IssueDetailPage.tsx` main render branch (lines 93–243) has NO "Back to issues" link. The link exists ONLY in the error/not-found branch (`IssueDetailPage.tsx:60–62`). Breadcrumbs (lines 96–100) don't satisfy the test's explicit `getByText("Back to issues")` assertion.

### Gap 2 — Raw issue ID never rendered (CONFIRMED, but masked in the test)
- `phase2-validation.spec.ts:803 'displays issue title and ID'` → FAILS at line 824 (the TITLE assertion), NOT at line 827 (the ID assertion). Failure is a strict-mode violation (see "Extra finding" below). The test never reaches `getByText(testIssueId)` at line 827.
- The gap itself is REAL: confirmed by (a) source — the main branch of `IssueDetailPage.tsx` never renders `issue.id`/`id` in the DOM; (b) the Playwright page snapshot (`test-results/phase2-validation-Phase-2--2d72f-displays-issue-title-and-ID-chromium/error-context.md`) — no issue ID appears anywhere in the rendered DOM.

### Gap 3 — Inline title edit unimplemented (CONFIRMED, but masked in the test)
- `phase2-validation.spec.ts:907 'inline edit title'` → FAILS at line 922 (the TITLE visibility assertion) with the same strict-mode violation, before reaching the click (line 923) or the input check (lines 926–927).
- The gap itself is REAL: `IssueDetailPage.tsx` has `editingDescription` state (line 43) for description editing but NO `editingTitle` state or title-edit logic. The title is passed only as a static string via `pageTitle={issue.title}` (line 95), rendered as a non-interactive `<h1>` (`AppLayout.tsx:19`). Clicking it does nothing; no `input.text-xl` ever appears.

### ⚠️ Additional finding the implementer MUST handle: title duplicated in the DOM
The original review (mqdzwvhlyo) didn't flag this, but it directly blocks the tests for Gaps 2 & 3: **the issue title is rendered twice** — once as the page `<h1>` (`AppLayout.tsx:19`, via `pageTitle={issue.title}`) and once as the last breadcrumb crumb (a `<span>`, via breadcrumbs ending with `{ label: issue.title }` at `IssueDetailPage.tsx:99`). This makes `getByText(issueTitle)` ambiguous → Playwright strict-mode violation.

**Implication:** Merely adding the ID display (Gap 2) and inline title edit (Gap 3) will NOT turn tests 3 & 4 green on their own. The title/breadcrumb duplication must also be resolved — either (a) stop echoing the title as the last breadcrumb crumb (or render it differently), or (b) the affected test selectors must be scoped (e.g. `getByRole("heading", ...)` instead of `getByText(...)`). This duplication is pre-existing (unchanged since `1afdf15`).

Artifacts: screenshots + traces + full page snapshots are under `packages/webapp/test-results/phase2-validation-Phase-2--*`.

content.content:
Done. Implemented the three IssueDetailPage gaps from the reproduction report:

1. Added a Back to issues link in the MAIN render branch of the detail page (mirrors the UsersPage style with a back-arrow icon). Previously it only existed in the error branch.
2. The raw issue ID is now rendered in the DOM, shown as a small subtitle directly under the title.
3. Implemented inline title editing, symmetric with the existing description edit: clicking the title reveals an input; Enter saves (PATCH), Escape cancels, blur cancels.

Also resolved the title duplication the validator flagged: the title was previously rendered both as the page heading and as the last breadcrumb crumb, which caused Playwright strict-mode violations on the title and ID tests. Removed the title from the breadcrumb (it now reads Dashboard then Issues).

Testing: frontend build and typecheck pass. Phase 2 e2e suite went from 51 passed and 4 failed to 55 passed and 0 failed, with all four previously-failing tests now green (navigation to and from detail page, title and ID display, inline title edit). Phases 1, 3, and 4 all pass as well (97 tests) with no regressions.

Files changed: IssueDetailPage.tsx and AppLayout.tsx (the latter gained an optional titleContent prop, fully backward compatible with the other pages).
